name: Beresheet
intro: Shalom! I'm Beresheet, which means 'In the beginning'.
I'm the first Moon lander built by a small private team, not a big space agency.
I'm the size of a dishwasher and I took the long, cheap way to the Moon.
I only need a couple of days to take photos and measure magnetism.
briefing: We are descending over Mare Serenitatis.
Something is wrong with a sensor... Quick, choose the site!
fact: Beresheet crashed, but it made Israel the 7th country to orbit the Moon. Its team tried again.

alarm.title: Main Engine Shutdown
alarm.briefing: A sensor glitch, a reset command... and the main engine switched OFF! In real life Beresheet crashed here. Can you choose a site and save it?
